name: Littara

skills.name: Quick Writing
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to them.

skills.name: Perfect Opportunity
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tiles to attack, dealing AoE Physical damage equal to 70% of attack to them and all enemy targets within a 2 tiles, applying Vulnerable I for 2 turns.

skills.name: Reliable Cover
skills.description: Select 1 direction  around self, deal AoE Physical damage equal to 65% of attack to all enemy targets within a 3x8 area, 2 tiles away in the selected direction and apply Defense Down II for 2 turns. Destroy all destructible Cover within that area, excluding a 3x3 area around self. For each target hit, reduce this skill's cooldown by 1 turn.

skills.name: Strategist's Plan
skills.description: Selects 1 tile within 8 tiles to launch an attack, dealing AoE Physical damage equal to 85% of attack to all enemy targets within 2 tiles. If the target has a defense debuff, change the damage dealt to AoE Physical damage equal to 95% of attack and 4 points of Stability Damage. Additionally, damage dealt to targets with defense debuffs is increased by 20%.

skills.name: Systematic Breakdown
skills.description: At the end of the action, deals AoE Physical damage equal to 30% of attack and 1 point of Stability Damage to the nearest target within range under a defense debuff, and gains 1 point of Confectance Index.

fortification.effect: The effect range increases to 3x8 tiles in front.
Damage dealt to targets with defense debuffs is increased by 20%.
Confectance Index consumption is reduced by 2 points.
Deals damage to 2 nearest enemy targets within range with a defense debuff.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Strategic Planning
keys.effect: Gains 3 points of Confectance Index at the start of the battle.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Gaining Experience
keys.effect: Gain 1 point of Confectance Index for every 3 instances of damage dealt.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Press the Advantage
keys.effect: When exploiting a Phase Weakness, randomly applies 1 debuff to the target after attacking for 2 turns.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Identifying Gaps
keys.effect: If the target has defense debuffs, increases critical rate by 15%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Battle Analysis
keys.effect: When using the active skill Perfect Opportunity. applies Attack Down I to all targets for 2 turns.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Aggressive Attack
keys.effect: Before using the active skill Reliable Cover, if no movement has been made, changes the type of damage dealt to AoE Burn damage.

keys.name: Common Key - Vulnerability Exploit
keys.effect: CRIT +3.0% / damage dealt to targets with defense debuffs is increased by 7%.

keys.name: Expansion Key
keys.effect: If the target has Defense type debuffs, increases damage dealt by 10% and ignores 15% of the damage reduction from Cover
